fields.summary: The guidance function shall compute a steering correction at least once every 20 ms while guidance mode is active.
The power manager shall shed non-essential loads within 100 ms of a bus undervoltage event.
Telemetry frames shall be encoded with a CRC-16 integrity field before transmission.
The system shall log every mode transition with a monotonic timestamp to non-volatile storage.
Static analysis finding FIND-1: possible null dereference in guidance.c — triage and fix.
Static analysis finding FIND-2: uninitialized variable in power_mgr.c — triage and fix.
